columns.standard_price: Standard Edition list price, local currency, as listed on the store
columns.standard_usd: standard_price x fx_usd_per_unit, rounded to cents
columns.standard_vs_us_pct: standard_usd vs the US Standard price on the same store, %
columns.ultimate_premium_pct: Ultimate price vs Standard price, same store, %
columns.standard_share_of_monthly_earnings_pct: standard_usd / earnings_monthly_usd x 100 (ILO average monthly earnings, 2021 or later only)
columns.tax_in_listed_price: included | excluded | unverified - whether the listed price includes consumer sales tax / VAT
columns.high_inflation: true when latest World Bank CPI inflation > 25%: income comparison less reliable
